### Module 05 — Clinical Text Preprocessing

# Capstone · End-to-End Clinical NLP Pipeline

***
**This capstone integrates NB-01 through NB-07 into a single production-ready clinical NLP pipeline.**

**Pipeline stages:**
1. Preprocessing: PHI de-identification, abbreviation expansion, section extraction
2. Named entity recognition: conditions, drugs, findings, symptoms
3. Structured value extraction: vitals, labs, medications
4. ICD-10 code suggestions
5. TF-IDF readmission prediction from note text
6. Hybrid features: TF-IDF + NLP-extracted values
7. Extractive summarisation + ROUGE evaluation
8. 8-panel publication figure at 300 dpi + methods narrative

**Research question:** Can NLP-derived features from discharge summaries improve 30-day readmission prediction over structured EHR features alone?

**Estimated time:** 4 hours | **Level:** Advanced

## 0. Setup & Helper Functions (from NB-01 to NB-07)

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(glmnet)
library(rsample)
library(yardstick)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)
mod05_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod05")
dir.create(mod05_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "grey40")
    )
)

# ── Abbreviation expansion (NB-01) ───────────────────────────────────────────
abbrevs <- c(
  DM2 = "type 2 diabetes", HTN = "hypertension", HF = "heart failure",
  CKD = "chronic kidney disease", COPD = "chronic obstructive pulmonary disease",
  PE = "pulmonary embolism", SOB = "shortness of breath", CP = "chest pain",
  HR = "heart rate", BP = "blood pressure", SpO2 = "oxygen saturation",
  EF = "ejection fraction", BNP = "brain natriuretic peptide",
  PO = "by mouth", IV = "intravenous", BID = "twice daily", QD = "once daily",
  Pt = "patient", pt = "patient"
)
expand_abbrevs <- function(text) {
  ord <- order(nchar(names(abbrevs)), decreasing = TRUE)
  for (i in ord) {
    pattern <- paste0("\\b", names(abbrevs)[i], "\\b")
    text <- stringr::str_replace_all(text, stringr::regex(pattern), unname(abbrevs[i]))
  }
  text
}

# ── PHI de-identification (NB-01) ───────────────────────────────────────────
phi_pats <- c(
  MRN  = "MRN\\s*:\\s*\\d{6,10}",
  DATE = "\\b\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}\\b",
  AGE  = "\\b\\d{2,3}\\s*(?:y/o|year[-\\s]old|yo)\\b"
)
deidentify <- function(text) {
  for (t in names(phi_pats)) {
    text <- stringr::str_replace_all(
      text, stringr::regex(phi_pats[[t]], ignore_case = TRUE), paste0("[", t, "]")
    )
  }
  text
}

# ── Vital/lab extraction (NB-01) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
vital_pats <- c(
  hr   = "HR\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})",
  sbp  = "BP\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})/(\\d{2,3})",
  spo2 = "SpO2\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})\\s*%",
  bnp  = "BNP\\s*(\\d{2,5})",
  cr   = "Cr\\s*(\\d\\.\\d)",
  ef   = "EF\\s*(\\d{2})\\s*%"
)
extract_vitals <- function(text) {
  vals <- list()
  for (name in names(vital_pats)) {
    m <- stringr::str_match(text, stringr::regex(vital_pats[[name]], ignore_case = TRUE))
    if (!is.na(m[1, 1])) {
      vals[[name]] <- as.numeric(if (name == "sbp") m[1, 2] else m[1, 2])
    }
  }
  vals
}

# ── NER (NB-02) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
entity_pats <- list(
  DISEASE = c("heart failure", "diabetes", "COPD", "sepsis", "pneumonia",
              "pulmonary embolism", "DKA", "ketoacidosis", "hypertension",
              "acute kidney injury", "myocardial infarction", "atrial fibrillation"),
  DRUG    = c("furosemide", "metformin", "insulin", "albuterol", "vancomycin",
              "carvedilol", "lisinopril", "sacubitril", "methylprednisolone",
              "ceftriaxone", "rivaroxaban", "aspirin", "spironolactone"),
  FINDING = c("bilateral pitting edema", "reduced ejection fraction", "hypercapnia",
              "volume overload", "bilateral infiltrates", "anion gap", "ST elevation")
)
count_ents <- function(text) {
  counts <- list()
  for (label in names(entity_pats)) {
    n <- 0L
    for (p in entity_pats[[label]]) {
      regex <- paste0("\\b", stringr::str_replace_all(p, "([\\W])", "\\\\\\1"), "\\b")
      if (stringr::str_detect(text, stringr::regex(regex, ignore_case = TRUE))) n <- n + 1L
    }
    counts[[label]] <- n
  }
  counts
}

# ── ICD-10 suggester (NB-06) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
icd10_ref <- tibble::tibble(
  code = c("I50.9", "J44.1", "E11.10", "A41.9", "J18.9"),
  desc = c("Heart failure", "COPD exacerbation", "DKA T2DM", "Sepsis", "Pneumonia"),
  kw   = c(
    "heart failure BNP furosemide edema ejection fraction",
    "COPD exacerbation bronchospasm albuterol wheezes steroids",
    "diabetic ketoacidosis DKA anion gap insulin glucose acidosis",
    "sepsis septic shock bacteremia lactate norepinephrine broad spectrum",
    "pneumonia consolidation fever antibiotics ceftriaxone WBC"
  )
)
icd_texts <- paste(icd10_ref$kw, icd10_ref$desc)
toks_icd <- quanteda::tokens(icd_texts, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
  quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
  quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_tfidf(quanteda::dfm(toks_icd))
if (nfeat(dfm_icd) > 200) {
  keep <- names(quanteda::topfeatures(dfm_icd, n = 200))
  dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_select(dfm_icd, pattern = keep)
}
icd_mat <- as.matrix(dfm_icd)

suggest_top1 <- function(text) {
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(tolower(text), remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
  d <- quanteda::dfm_match(quanteda::dfm(toks), features = colnames(icd_mat))
  vec <- as.numeric(as.matrix(d))
  nrms <- sqrt(rowSums(icd_mat^2)); nrms[nrms == 0] <- 1
  vn <- sqrt(sum(vec^2)); if (vn == 0) vn <- 1
  scores <- as.numeric((icd_mat / nrms) %*% (vec / vn))
  icd10_ref$code[which.max(scores)]
}

cat("All helper functions loaded from NB-01 to NB-07 modules.\n")
```

## 1. Synthetic Clinical Notes Corpus (N=400)

```{r}
templates <- list(
  HF = c(
    paste("Patient admitted acute decompensated heart failure BNP {bnp} EF {ef}%",
          "bilateral pitting edema IV furosemide diuresis carvedilol lisinopril sacubitril",
          "creatinine {cr} discharge stable follow-up cardiology."),
    paste("Heart failure reduced ejection fraction {ef}% BNP {bnp} volume overload",
          "IV diuresis new spironolactone uptitration GDMT creatinine {cr} euvolemic discharge.")
  ),
  COPD = c(
    paste("COPD exacerbation SpO2 {spo2}% albuterol ipratropium methylprednisolone",
          "azithromycin possible pneumonia supplemental oxygen bronchospasm wheezes discharge."),
    paste("COPD GOLD III exacerbation bronchodilators systemic corticosteroids SpO2 {spo2}%",
          "hypoxia supplemental oxygen home pulmonology follow-up discharge.")
  ),
  DM = c(
    paste("Diabetic ketoacidosis glucose {glucose} anion gap {gap} insulin drip IV fluids",
          "potassium replacement endocrine consult metformin empagliflozin discharge education."),
    paste("Uncontrolled type 2 diabetes HbA1c 11.2 GLP-1 agonist SGLT2 inhibitor intensification",
          "glucose {glucose} diabetes education discharge endocrinology follow-up.")
  ),
  SEPSIS = c(
    paste("Septic shock BP {bp} lactate {lactate} norepinephrine vasopressor",
          "vancomycin meropenem blood cultures creatinine {cr} ICU step-down discharge antibiotics."),
    paste("Bacteremia blood cultures positive vancomycin antibiotics echocardiogram",
          "lactate {lactate} BP {bp} infectious disease consult discharge oral antibiotics.")
  )
)
readmit_prob <- c(HF = 0.62, COPD = 0.35, DM = 0.45, SEPSIS = 0.58)
expected_icd <- c(HF = "I50.9", COPD = "J44.1", DM = "E11.10", SEPSIS = "A41.9")

fill_template <- function(tmpl) {
  stringr::str_replace_all(tmpl, c(
    "\\{bnp\\}"     = as.character(sample(400:2199, 1)),
    "\\{ef\\}"      = as.character(sample(20:47, 1)),
    "\\{cr\\}"      = sprintf("%.1f", runif(1, 0.9, 3.2)),
    "\\{spo2\\}"    = as.character(sample(83:95, 1)),
    "\\{glucose\\}" = as.character(sample(360:559, 1)),
    "\\{gap\\}"     = as.character(sample(18:29, 1)),
    "\\{bp\\}"      = paste0(sample(65:81, 1), "/", sample(36:47, 1)),
    "\\{lactate\\}" = sprintf("%.1f", runif(1, 2.4, 6.2))
  ))
}

set.seed(SEED)
corpus <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(400), function(i) {
  cond <- sample(names(templates), 1)
  text <- fill_template(sample(templates[[cond]], 1))
  readmitted <- as.integer(runif(1) < readmit_prob[[cond]])
  vitals <- extract_vitals(text)
  ents   <- count_ents(text)
  tibble::tibble(
    note_id        = sprintf("N%04d", i - 1),
    text           = deidentify(expand_abbrevs(text)),
    raw_text       = text,
    condition      = cond,
    readmitted     = readmitted,
    note_length    = length(strsplit(text, "\\s+")[[1]]),
    bnp_extracted  = if (!is.null(vitals$bnp))  vitals$bnp  else NA_real_,
    cr_extracted   = if (!is.null(vitals$cr))   vitals$cr   else NA_real_,
    ef_extracted   = if (!is.null(vitals$ef))   vitals$ef   else NA_real_,
    spo2_extracted = if (!is.null(vitals$spo2)) vitals$spo2 else NA_real_,
    n_disease_ents = ents$DISEASE,
    n_drug_ents    = ents$DRUG,
    n_finding_ents = ents$FINDING,
    suggested_icd  = suggest_top1(text),
    expected_icd   = expected_icd[[cond]]
  )
})

df <- corpus
cat(sprintf("Corpus: %d notes | Readmission rate: %.1f%%\n",
            nrow(df), 100 * mean(df$readmitted)))
cat("Condition breakdown:\n")
print(table(df$condition, df$readmitted))
```

## 2. NLP Feature Pipeline

```{r}
stops <- c("patient", "the", "a", "an", "was", "were", "for", "and", "or", "with",
           "at", "in", "to", "of", "mg", "daily", "admission", "discharge",
           "history", "hospital", "follow", "started", "noted")

struct_cols <- c("note_length", "n_disease_ents", "n_drug_ents", "n_finding_ents",
                 "bnp_extracted", "cr_extracted", "ef_extracted", "spo2_extracted")

set.seed(SEED)
split <- rsample::initial_split(df, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
train <- rsample::training(split)
test  <- rsample::testing(split)

make_tfidf <- function(texts, train_dfm = NULL) {
  texts <- as.character(texts)
  names(texts) <- paste0("doc", seq_along(texts))
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(texts, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
    quanteda::tokens_remove(stops) |>
    quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
  d <- quanteda::dfm(toks)
  if (is.null(train_dfm)) {
    keep_n <- min(500L, nfeat(d))
    keep <- names(quanteda::topfeatures(d, n = keep_n))
    d <- quanteda::dfm_select(d, pattern = keep)
    quanteda::dfm_tfidf(d)
  } else {
    d <- quanteda::dfm_match(d, features = quanteda::featnames(train_dfm))
    quanteda::dfm_tfidf(d)
  }
}

dtr <- make_tfidf(train$text)
dte <- make_tfidf(test$text, train_dfm = dtr)
x_tr_tfidf <- as.matrix(dtr)
x_te_tfidf <- as.matrix(dte)

impute_median <- function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
}
scale_mat <- function(tr, te) {
  tr <- apply(tr, 2, impute_median)
  te <- apply(te, 2, impute_median)
  mu <- colMeans(tr); sdv <- apply(tr, 2, sd); sdv[sdv == 0] <- 1
  list(tr = scale(tr, center = mu, scale = sdv),
       te = scale(te, center = mu, scale = sdv))
}
sc <- scale_mat(as.matrix(train[, struct_cols]), as.matrix(test[, struct_cols]))
x_tr_struct <- sc$tr
x_te_struct <- sc$te

x_tr_tfidf[!is.finite(x_tr_tfidf)] <- 0
x_te_tfidf[!is.finite(x_te_tfidf)] <- 0
x_tr_struct[!is.finite(x_tr_struct)] <- 0
x_te_struct[!is.finite(x_te_struct)] <- 0

x_tr_hybrid <- cbind(x_tr_tfidf, x_tr_struct)
x_te_hybrid <- cbind(x_te_tfidf, x_te_struct)

cat(sprintf("TF-IDF features    : %d\n", ncol(x_tr_tfidf)))
cat(sprintf("Structured features: %d\n", ncol(x_tr_struct)))
cat(sprintf("Hybrid features    : %d\n", ncol(x_tr_hybrid)))
```

## 3. Readmission Prediction — Feature Comparison

```{r}
y_tr <- train$readmitted
y_te <- test$readmitted

fit_eval <- function(xtr, xte) {
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(xtr, y_tr, family = "binomial",
                        lambda = 0.01, maxit = 1000)
  p <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = xte, type = "response"))
  pred <- as.integer(p >= 0.5)
  tibble::tibble(
    AUC = yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    AP  = yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    F1  = yardstick::f_meas_vec(factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)),
                                factor(pred, levels = c(0, 1)), event_level = "second")
  )
}

feature_sets <- list(
  "Structured NLP only" = list(tr = x_tr_struct, te = x_te_struct),
  "TF-IDF text only"    = list(tr = x_tr_tfidf,  te = x_te_tfidf),
  "TF-IDF + Structured" = list(tr = x_tr_hybrid, te = x_te_hybrid)
)
results_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(feature_sets, function(fs, name) {
  met <- fit_eval(fs$tr, fs$te)
  cat(sprintf("  %-24s: AUC=%.4f | AP=%.4f | F1=%.4f\n",
              name, met$AUC, met$AP, met$F1))
  dplyr::bind_cols(tibble::tibble(`Feature set` = name), round(met, 4))
})
struct_auc <- results_df$AUC[1]
hybrid_auc <- results_df$AUC[3]
cat(sprintf("\nNLP text gain over structured only: %+.4f\n", hybrid_auc - struct_auc))
```

## 5. Extraction Rate Analysis

```{r}
stops_summ <- c(quanteda::stopwords("en"),
                "patient", "mg", "daily", "was", "were", "the", "a", "an",
                "admission", "discharge", "hospital")

split_sentences <- function(text) {
  sents <- unlist(quanteda::tokens(text, what = "sentence"))
  sents <- stringr::str_squish(sents)
  n_words <- vapply(strsplit(sents, "\\s+"), length, integer(1))
  sents[n_words > 5]
}

textrank_summarise <- function(text, n_sents = 4) {
  sents <- split_sentences(text)
  if (length(sents) <= n_sents) return(sents)
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(sents, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
    quanteda::tokens_remove(stops_summ)
  d <- quanteda::dfm_tfidf(quanteda::dfm(toks))
  mat <- as.matrix(d)
  if (nrow(mat) == 0 || ncol(mat) == 0) return(sents[seq_len(n_sents)])
  nrms <- sqrt(rowSums(mat^2)); nrms[nrms == 0] <- 1
  sim <- tcrossprod(mat / nrms); diag(sim) <- 0
  n <- nrow(sim)
  scores <- rep(1 / n, n)
  for (iter in seq_len(50)) {
    rs <- rowSums(sim); rs[rs == 0] <- 1
    scores <- 0.15 / n + 0.85 * as.numeric(t(sim / rs) %*% scores)
  }
  sents[sort(order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(n_sents)])]
}

missing_pct <- colMeans(is.na(df[, c("bnp_extracted", "cr_extracted",
                                     "ef_extracted", "spo2_extracted")])) * 100
present_pct <- 100 - missing_pct
cat("Structured value extraction rates:\n")
for (col in names(present_pct)) {
  bar <- strrep("\u2588", as.integer(present_pct[[col]] / 5))
  cat(sprintf("  %-18s: %5.1f%% %s\n", col, present_pct[[col]], bar))
}
```

## 6. Publication Summary Figure (8 panels, 300 dpi)

The Python notebook laid out six plotted panels on a 3×4 grid (A–F). The same six views are produced here with ggplot2 + patchwork.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
cond_colors <- c(HF = "#DC2626", COPD = "#2563EB", DM = "#16A34A", SEPSIS = "#D4A017")

# A — Note length by readmission
p_a <- ggplot(df, aes(x = note_length, fill = factor(readmitted))) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, alpha = 0.6,
                 position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#2563EB", "1" = "#DC2626"),
                    labels = c("Not readmitted", "Readmitted")) +
  labs(title = "A  Note length by readmission",
       x = "Note length (words)", y = "Density", fill = NULL)

# B — Feature comparison AUC
p_b <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = `Feature set`, y = AUC, fill = `Feature set`)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", AUC)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#AEC6CF", "#2563EB", "#DC2626"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 1.0)) +
  labs(title = "B  Feature comparison AUC", y = "AUC-ROC", x = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 12, hjust = 1))

# C — NER counts by readmission
ner_long <- ner_by_readmit |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-readmitted, names_to = "entity", values_to = "mean_n") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    entity = dplyr::recode(entity,
                           n_disease_ents = "Disease",
                           n_drug_ents    = "Drug",
                           n_finding_ents = "Finding"),
    outcome = ifelse(readmitted == 1, "Readmitted", "Not readmitted")
  )
p_c <- ggplot(ner_long, aes(x = entity, y = mean_n, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(title = "C  NER entity counts by outcome",
       y = "Mean entity count", x = NULL, fill = NULL)

# D — ICD-10 confusion matrix
icd_df <- as.data.frame(icd_cm)
p_d <- ggplot(icd_df, aes(x = Suggested, y = Expected, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2563EB") +
  labs(title = sprintf("D  ICD-10 accuracy (%.0f%%)", 100 * icd_acc),
       x = "Suggested", y = "Expected") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# E — Readmission rate by condition
cond_re <- df |>
  dplyr::group_by(condition) |>
  dplyr::summarise(rate = 100 * mean(readmitted), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rate))
p_e <- ggplot(cond_re, aes(x = reorder(condition, -rate), y = rate, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", rate)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "E  Readmission rate by condition",
       y = "Readmission rate (%)", x = NULL)

# F — Structured value extraction rate
ext_df <- tibble::tibble(
  label = c("BNP", "Creatinine", "EF", "SpO2"),
  rate  = as.numeric(present_pct)
)
p_f <- ggplot(ext_df, aes(x = label, y = rate, fill = label)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", rate)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 80, colour = "#16A34A", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(BNP = "#2563EB", Creatinine = "#DC2626",
                               EF = "#16A34A", SpO2 = "#B47CC7"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 115)) +
  labs(title = "F  Structured value extraction",
       y = "Extraction rate (%)", x = NULL)

fig <- (p_a | p_b) / (p_c | p_d) / (p_e | p_f) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "End-to-End Clinical NLP Pipeline (N=400 Discharge Summaries)"
  )
print(fig)
ggsave(file.path(mod05_dir, "capstone_nlp_summary.png"), fig,
       width = 20, height = 14, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: capstone_nlp_summary.png (300 dpi)\n")
```

## 7. Sample Extraction Report for One Note

```{r}
sample <- df[6, ]
raw <- sample$raw_text

cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("CLINICAL NLP EXTRACTION REPORT\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Note ID    : %s\n", sample$note_id))
cat(sprintf("Condition  : %s\n", sample$condition))
cat(sprintf("Readmitted : %s\n\n", if (sample$readmitted == 1) "YES" else "No"))
cat("STRUCTURED VALUES EXTRACTED:\n")
for (field in c("bnp_extracted", "cr_extracted", "ef_extracted", "spo2_extracted")) {
  val <- sample[[field]]
  name <- toupper(sub("_extracted", "", field))
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s: %s\n", name, if (is.na(val)) "not found" else as.character(val)))
}
cat("\nNER ENTITY COUNTS:\n")
for (field in c("n_disease_ents", "n_drug_ents", "n_finding_ents")) {
  name <- toupper(gsub("_ents", " entities", sub("^n_", "", field)))
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s: %s\n", name, sample[[field]]))
}
cat(sprintf("\nSUGGESTED ICD-10 : %s\n", sample$suggested_icd))
cat(sprintf("EXPECTED ICD-10  : %s\n", sample$expected_icd))
cat(sprintf("MATCH            : %s\n\n",
            if (sample$suggested_icd == sample$expected_icd) "YES" else "NO"))

summary_sents <- textrank_summarise(sample$text, n_sents = 3)
cat("EXTRACTIVE SUMMARY (TextRank, 3 sentences):\n")
for (i in seq_along(summary_sents)) {
  cat(sprintf("  [%d] %s\n", i, stringr::str_squish(summary_sents[i])))
}
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
```

## 8. Methods Narrative (Template)

> **Clinical NLP Methods**
>
> Discharge summaries (N=400) were preprocessed through a rule-based pipeline: PHI de-identification (regex for MRN, dates, ages), clinical abbreviation expansion (20-term dictionary), and section header extraction (8 section types).
>
> Named entities were identified using a lexicon-based gazetteer (EntityRuler analogue) with 40+ clinical patterns across 3 entity types (DISEASE, DRUG, FINDING) with window-based negation detection (5-token look-back window). Structured values (BNP, creatinine, EF, SpO2) were extracted using clinical measurement regex patterns.
>
> ICD-10 code suggestions were generated via cosine similarity between TF-IDF representations of note text and ICD-10 keyword descriptions (top-1 accuracy: XX%). Medication extraction used a drug name lexicon (80+ drugs) with dose/route/frequency capture patterns.
>
> Readmission prediction compared three feature sets: (1) structured NLP-extracted values only, (2) TF-IDF unigram+bigram features, and (3) hybrid TF-IDF + structured — all trained with logistic regression (glmnet, balanced via intercept). Extractive summarisation used TextRank with cosine-similarity-based sentence scoring.
>
> All analyses used R 4.3+ (quanteda, tidytext, glmnet, text2vec, stringr).

## 9. Knowledge Check
1. Hybrid TF-IDF + structured improved AUC over structured-only. Would this replicate on real MIMIC-IV data? What confounders exist?
2. ICD-10 accuracy is 78%. Describe two approaches to improve to >90%.
3. NER has 0.71 DISEASE recall. The 29% missed are mostly negated mentions. What is the clinical impact?
4. The regex medication extractor achieves 85% drug detection but 60% dose detection. What patterns are commonly missed?
5. Simulate inter-annotator agreement between human coders and your NLP pipeline using Cohen's kappa.

```{r}
set.seed(42)
icd_codes <- c("I50.9", "J44.1", "E11.10", "A41.9", "J18.9")
n_notes <- 50
human_codes <- sample(icd_codes, n_notes, replace = TRUE)
# NLP agrees ~78% of the time
agree <- runif(n_notes) < 0.78
nlp_codes <- ifelse(agree, human_codes, sample(icd_codes, n_notes, replace = TRUE))

h_f <- factor(human_codes, levels = icd_codes)
n_f <- factor(nlp_codes,   levels = icd_codes)
kappa <- yardstick::kap_vec(h_f, n_f)
acc   <- mean(h_f == n_f)

cat(sprintf("Human vs NLP ICD coding agreement (simulated n=%d):\n", n_notes))
cat(sprintf("  Accuracy       : %.1f%%\n", 100 * acc))
cat(sprintf("  Cohen's kappa  : %.3f\n", kappa))
level <- if (kappa > 0.6) "Substantial" else if (kappa > 0.4) "Moderate" else if (kappa > 0.2) "Fair" else "Slight"
cat(sprintf("  Agreement level: %s\n\n", level))
cat("Kappa guide:\n")
cat("  k > 0.80 : Almost perfect\n")
cat("  k 0.61-0.80: Substantial  <- target for clinical NLP deployment\n")
cat("  k 0.41-0.60: Moderate\n")
cat("  k 0.21-0.40: Fair\n")
cat("  k < 0.20 : Slight\n")
```
